_comment: Light Warrior ACTION, so it resolves on PLAY — it was ability_type STATIC and never fired. Four separate defects: (1) gated on an invented BOLTYN_SPECIALIZATION_ACTIVE flag, and Specialization is a META-STATIC DECKBUILDING restriction (CR 8.3.7, 'functional outside the game') that is never an in-game condition, so the gate was conceptually wrong as well as dead; (2) 'until end of turn weapons gain +1{p}' was a MODIFY_ATTACK on the CURRENT attack instead of MODIFY_ATTACKS_THIS_TURN filtered to weapons; (3) the injected trigger had trigger_type 'TRIGGERED' with the real trigger in a sibling key, so it could not bind; (4) its Light branch put the revealed card on the BOTTOM OF DECK when the text says put it into your hero's SOUL. NEEDS_NEW_DSL for two clauses: the on-hit reveal needs a deck->soul move (which is NOT charging, per CR 8.5.29b), and 'attack an additional time with each weapon' needs an extra-attack grant that no effect provides. Both are omitted rather than left doing something wrong.
